note: RCE-026 freshness targets. Lag is measured from the commit timestamp to the moment indexing completed, not from when the sync was triggered — a slow trigger is still a slow answer.

mergeToIndexedLagSeconds.rationale: Sync is triggered by CI after merge on main. Fifteen minutes keeps an answer within one review cycle; a day-old index is a different repository.

reconciliationDriftCommits.rationale: Any drift means answers describe a snapshot nobody is working on. One commit is tolerable between merge and sync; ten means the pipeline is broken.

staleAnswerBehaviour.rationale: The engine cannot prevent drift, but it must never present a drifted or tree-dirty snapshot as current. A pack that omits its freshness state is a contract breach even when the data is fresh.
